hero_p: Privacy-first tools built for people, not for procurement — priced fairly and shipped without the tracking.
val_p: Four principles that don't change no matter how big we get.
v1_p: Every product is built encryption-first, with zero telemetry and zero third-party trackers by default — not bolted on after the fact.
v2_p: Privacy tools shouldn't feel like a downgrade. Everything we ship is built to compete with — and beat — the mainstream alternative.
v3_p: Fair pricing isn't a launch promotion. Free stays genuinely useful, and paid tiers stay affordable as we grow.
v4_p: You're the customer, not the product. Every decision starts with what's good for the person using the software.
about_p1: Ametrine Foundation builds software the way we'd want to use it ourselves — private by default, fast, and honestly priced.
about_p2: We're small on purpose. No investors to please, no growth targets that force compromises on the things that actually matter to the people using our tools.
how_p: Three principles guide every release, from the first line of code to the day it ships.
tl1_p: Privacy isn't a setting you toggle on — it's the foundation every feature is designed around from day one.
tl2_p: We optimise as hard for speed as we do for privacy, so protecting your data never means a slower product.
tl3_p: Every release goes out with a free tier that's genuinely usable, not a crippled trial designed to push upgrades.
rel_p: Short updates here — full write-ups and changelogs on Ko-fi.
rel1_desc: Performance improvements across the board, plus the new privacy dashboard for Premium members.
rel2_desc: Bug fixes and stability improvements based on community feedback from the last update.
kofi_s: Back the project, get early access
kofi_p: Ko-fi memberships fund development directly — no investors, no ads, no data deals. Just people supporting software they actually want to exist.
kofi_b1: Early access to every release, 2–3 weeks ahead of public
kofi_b2: Beta tester status and a direct line to the team
vis_q: We believe software should serve the person using it, not the company selling it — and that privacy and performance were never actually a trade-off.
pri_p: No enterprise sales calls, no hidden tiers. One free plan that's genuinely useful, one paid plan that's genuinely fair.
free_desc: Everything you need to get started, with no artificial limits designed to push an upgrade.
prem_desc: For people who want to support development directly and get new features first.
fd1_d: Full access to the core product suite, updated with every release.
fd2_d: Standard privacy settings covering encryption, telemetry, and data retention.
fd3_d: Zero data collection, zero third-party sharing, by default.
fd4_d: Community support via docs and the community forum.
pd1_d: New releases and features land for Premium members 2–3 weeks before public release.
pd2_d: Direct access to beta builds and a feedback channel straight to the team.
pd3_d: Advanced privacy settings beyond the Free tier defaults, including granular data controls.
pd4_d: Priority support with faster response times on every ticket.
pd5_d: Billed monthly through Ko-fi — cancel anytime, no long-term contract.
cta_p: No credit card, no catch — just software built the way it should be.
ft_tag: Privacy-first software, built for people — not procurement.
